What I'm working on at the moment.

## Research

Working out how social contact, mobility and attitude data can be used to
understand and help anticipate the behavioural drivers of epidemic dynamics — the first
substantive stretch of the PhD.

Alongside it, hepatitis B progression models for evaluating emergency department
blood-borne virus opt-out testing, and micro-costing of digitally enhanced BBV
testing.

## Elsewhere

Representing early career researchers at the Centre for the Mathematical
Modelling of Infectious Diseases, which mostly means helping organise the
monthly meetings we hold between ourselves.

{{< var personal.aside >}}

I write the occasional blog post on [Substack](https://laburton.substack.com),
usually about something I've been interested in, partly to get better at writing.
